patterns.note: The site uses a single-page layout structured around a very tall, immersive hero section followed by a type specimen area and a footer, with content generally centered horizontally.

The entire site acts as a showcase for the 'MD Nichrome' typeface, utilizing its various weights and styles extensively for all headings, display text, and even some body elements, creating a strong typographic identity.

A limited, sophisticated color palette of dark blues/greys and a light beige is used for backgrounds and primary text, with vibrant accent colors (orange, pink, blue) introduced sparingly within the type specimen section to highlight different styles.

The initial hero section, featuring a large display title and a gradient background, scrolls completely out of view, revealing a minimalist navigation bar that then becomes sticky at the top of the page.
The primary content area is dedicated to a comprehensive type specimen, displaying the font in numerous sizes, weights, and contexts, rather than traditional marketing sections.

technique_notes: The initial full-height hero section, featuring a large display title and a gradient background, scrolls up and out of view. As it scrolls, a minimalist navigation bar is revealed at the top of the page, which then becomes sticky once the hero content is fully off-screen. The background also transitions from a gradient to a solid color during this scroll.

The site's visual identity is built around showcasing its own product, a typeface, by using it as the primary design element for all textual content, from massive display headlines to functional navigation links.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized display headings (hero title is approximately 10x body text size) with a wide range of weights and styles showcased, contrasted with smaller, functional body and navigation text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant vertical whitespace in the hero and main content areas, transitioning to a denser but well-structured type specimen grid.

standout: This site stands out as a dedicated, highly focused type specimen page that uses its own product—a typeface—as the core of its visual design. The minimal aesthetic and scroll-triggered reveal of the navigation create an elegant, immersive experience centered entirely on showcasing the font's versatility and character.
